    *   **Why it works:** This is a popular choice for oily skin because it contains Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) to improve skin texture and tone, alongside "Matmarine," which specifically targets excess sebum and shine. It is non-comedogenic and free of essential oils.

*   **[kazima.co.in](https://www.kazima.co.in/products/10-niacinamide-face-serum-30ml) – 10% Niacinamide Face Serum with Zinc & Rice Extract (Approx. ₹465)**
    *   **Best for:** Fading dark spots and balancing oil.
    *   **Why it works:** It uses a high concentration of Niacinamide combined with Zinc to help soothe irritation. The inclusion of rice extract assists in brightening and improving overall skin texture, making it suitable for those dealing with persistent acne marks.

*   **[apollopharmacy.in](https://www.apollopharmacy.in/otc/plix-jamun-acne-marks-treatment-dewy-serum-30ml) – Plix Jamun Acne Marks Treatment Serum (Price varies, usually <₹600)**
    *   **Best for:** A combination of exfoliation and spot treatment.
    *   **Why it works:** This formula uses 10% Niacinamide, but sets itself apart by including 5% PHA (a gentle exfoliant) and Jamun extract, which has antimicrobial properties. It is designed specifically to help clear existing acne while gently removing dead skin cells to fade old marks.

*   **[amazon.in](https://www.amazon.in/Dermistry-Salicylic-Vitamin-Pimples-Blemishes/dp/B0CTXDQJ3Z) – Dermistry 2% Salicylic Acid + 5% Niacinamide Serum (Approx. ₹299)**
    *   **Best for:** Active breakouts and unclogging pores.
    *   **Why it works:** If you have *active* pimples alongside your marks, Salicylic Acid is a powerhouse ingredient. It penetrates deep into the pores to clear out the congestion that causes pimples, while the Niacinamide helps manage the subsequent dark spots.

*   **[homeoved.com](https://homeoved.com/product/alyoor-face-serum-for-acne-pimples-30ml-alpha-arbutin-2-niacinamide-2-hyaluronic-acid-brightening-oil-control-acne-marks-reduction-serum-for-oily-acne-prone-sensitive-skin/) – Alyoor Face Serum for Acne & Pimples (Approx. ₹379)**

### Quick Tips for Application:
1.  **Consistency is Key:** Niacinamide and active treatments usually take 2–4 weeks of consistent twice-daily use to show visible fading of acne marks.
2.  **Sunscreen is Mandatory:** When using serums that target marks (especially those with mild exfoliants or brightening agents), your skin can become more sensitive to the sun. Always use a lightweight, non-comedogenic sunscreen during the day to prevent the marks from getting darker.
3.  **Patch Test:** Before applying a new serum to your full face, always do a patch test on your jawline or inner arm to ensure you don't have a reaction.
